title: Weird synchronicity running into this sub
content: It's funny, I've never seen this sub in my life, but just yesterday or the day before I woke up with this very strange realization. All my dreams seemed linked to similar places in reality that I know of, and feel like a very static world and environment that I keep going through. I grew up in San Francisco. It was this one dream where I realized I was basically in a dream version of Golden Gate Park, a place I used to visit a ton. It was like the park, but strange and surreal, larger, a more fantastic version of itself. Some people lived there in like log cabins, sparsely occupied. It was kind of like a strange dreamlike campground with elements from GGP. I woke up and realized, I had been there before in my dreams, a LOT. I almost feel like I have a basic map of it in my mind, and it's like GGP. After that realization, I started having other dreams that I realized were places I've been before in my dreams... But also synonymous with SF areas. I was at a BART station. It was massive and strange, train tracks going everywhere, massive numbers of lines, into the sky, the ground, everywhere, suspended in air. It was scary, because of the heights of everything. People travelled there, some people robbed others. Somewhat dangerous, but not very. You just have to get a ticket and find the line you want to take, but that's hard in the dreamworld. I never managed it, though I have hopped on lines that just connected to other stations. I got there in a dream from a place that is more dangerous. There's this one hill. It's like the Turk and Leavenworth corner (tons of drug deals, some murders) and in the tenderloin (very dangerous part of SF). I don't think there's a bart station too near there, but this one exits close by. You will absolutely get robbed in this area of the dreamworld if you're not careful. There are gangs here. It's been several nightmares where I've had to run away from here, usually trying to get to BART where it's more safe, or hiding in residential areas. I've had similar dreams in this place many times, just now realizing "where" it is. Then there's the Cliff House, a cliff next to ocean beach, pretty high up. I've been here very often. I was here, and it was a bit of a nightmare but there was a lot of sort of vampires in this area. There was a bar around where the cliff house is (and I believe a real bar there in the restaurant in awake sf). I got kinda stuck with vampires, might've even been turned into one temporarily. The cliff here is taller, and there's wooden stairs and platforms all alongside it. People live there, but there are something like more monstrous vampires crawling around it. Strangely I don't remember other areas yet, but I've had this very odd feeling the last day or two that these places felt very real and synonymous to San Francisco, and I felt I've been there so many times in dreams. Then just today someone linked this sub and it feels related.
